denominator_contract: Every analytical row states its denominator definition and response type.
missingness_contract: Missing metadata is reported as missing and is never converted to zero.

rows.denominator_definition: the deliberately stratified lead-author sample from the five-source pipeline at the time of audit
rows.measure: Concordance with the five-source pipeline decision
rows.note: This check predates the Scopus extension and later objective eligibility corrections; it does not validate the final six-source corpus or the 1,244 Scopus records. Fifteen human-pipeline differences did not receive the planned second-human resolution. It is not accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, or an independent reference standard.
rows.response_type: lead-author oversight concordance; not a representative random sample
